_comment: src/assets/objects/long_pole.png を作り直すためのレシピ。build.py が読む。
**配置を描いて渡す（sketch: pole）。** 丸太と同じで、まっすぐな棒の姿勢と太さは生成では
決まらない（prompts/objects.json の log 参照）。形が単純なぶん、下絵で決めるほうが速い。
**紛れる相手が3つある。** 丸太（太さ）・太い枝（長さと、端まで同じ太さであること）・槍
（穂先と紐が無いこと）で、編集の指示ではこの3点を名指しで言う。
**端は折れ口ではなく切り口。** 拾った太い枝と違い、刃物で断って枝を払った棒なので、
両端に斜めの切り口を見せる。
**色を緑寄りに言うと、塗った棒になる。** 切ったばかりの生木のつもりで greenish brown と
書いた版は、一様なオリーブ色のつるりとした棒になった。warm mid brown を主にして、緑は
faintly と添えるだけにする。**節と輪も名指しで否定する**——太さが一定なので、放っておくと
段は400、対角線へ倒す（diagonal）。2mの長さが見せ場で、そこは槍と同じ

edit.prompt: Redraw this flat diagram as a soft hand painted illustration on a plain empty white page, keeping the same layout: one long slender wooden pole lying flat on the ground, running corner to corner across the page with its lower end at the bottom left and its upper end at the top right, in exactly the same place at the same angle and the same length. Paint it as one straight pole cut from a young tree, slim and exactly the same thickness from one end to the other, never tapering. It is wrapped in thin bark of warm mid brown wood, faintly greenish in places, marked with fine darker lengthwise lines and small pale flecks, its surface slightly uneven, rough and matte, never smooth or polished or painted. There are no rings or joints or nodes around it: this is a young tree, not bamboo and not a cane. At each end show a small pale cut face of the wood, cleanly sliced through at a slant where a blade cut it. The pole has no side branches, no twigs, no leaves, no knots and no splintered or broken ends. Nothing is tied or fixed to it: no stone point, no blade, no cord, no binding of any kind. Keep the plain empty white page with a wide white margin all around, and put one soft grey shadow on the ground beneath the pole. Everything in the picture is clearly darker than the white page, and nothing has a white outline, a pale rim or a glow around it. Dry matte surface, flat even lighting. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signature.
